title: National school. Meade’s yard. The hazard.
html_source: In sequence along Great Brunswick (now Pearse) Street: 114-121, St/ Andrews Boys' and Girls' National School; 153-159, Michael Meade & Son, builders and contractors, sawing, planing, and moulding mills, and joinery works; the hazard, Cabman’s Shelter and Coffee Stand outside Westland Row station.

anchor.text: National school. Meade's yard. The hazard.
anchor.prefix: up the envelope? Yes. Where did I put her letter after I read it in the bath? He patted his waistcoatpocket. There all right. Dear Henry fled. Before my patience are exhausted.
anchor.suffix: Only two there now. Nodding. Full as a tick. Too much bone in their skulls. The other trotting round with a fare. An hour ago I was passing there. The jarvies raised their hats.
